messages:
Maya: Morning! Tiny request — need a 25–35 minute show/episode to watch tonight while I bake sourdough, plus one song to keep me in the zone. Nothing too intense, something cozy or bittersweet. Hit me with recs :)
Liam: 'Feel Good' S1 E1 is ~25m, very warm + awkward. Song: 'Bon Iver — Holocene' :sparkles:
Devon: If you want something chill and weird, 'Documentary Now!' shorts (S2 eps are ~15–30m). Song: 'Khruangbin — Time (You and I)' — great for kneading.
Olga: 'Master of None' S1 E1 is 30m and pairs well. Song: 'Sufjan Stevens — Mystery of Love' (soft) :bread:
TuneBot: Playlist suggestion: 'Baking Mornings' — https://open.spotify.com/playlist/fakeid (curated lo-fi + indie) — sample track: 'Mac DeMarco — Chamber of Reflection'
Maya: These are perfect. Devon — Documentary Now! link? any ep rec?
Devon: Try S2E4 (the Hitchcock sendup) or S1E3. Both ~20-25m and pretty silly. Guide: https://www.example.com/documentary-now-ep-guide
Liam: If you want TV-adjacent movie short, 'The Trip' is a slow-burn 100m but great if you slow bake and watch in chunks :grimacing:
Olga: Quick poll — 'Feel Good' vs 'Documentary Now!'? React :thumbsup: for Feel Good, :heart: for Doc Now!
Maya: Going with Doc Now! S2E4 + Khruangbin for the kneading playlist. Thanks y'all :sparkling_heart:
